schemes.note: Fly.io tokens (e.g. FlyV1fm2_..., a macaroon) carry their own Authorization scheme word. Verified live 2026-09-03 against https://api.machines.dev/v1/apps/tovu/machines with two independently generated tokens: 'Authorization: Bearer FlyV1fm2_...' (whole token) returned 401 {"error":"Authenticate: token validation error"}; 'Authorization: FlyV1 fm2_...' (FlyV1 moved to the scheme, remainder as the value) returned 200 with real machine data. Both tokens behaved identically, so it is a scheme problem, not scope or expiry. The 401's WWW-Authenticate header (Basic realm="api.machines.dev") does not name the real scheme, so it cannot be derived from the server's challenge and must be declared here.
